definitions.meaning: A scenario passes when all of its checks pass and the agent replied to every caller turn. 'Untestable' means a check could not be applied, for example the agent never talked long enough to be interrupted.
From the caller's last sound in a turn to the agent's first sound. Turns where the agent was already talking are left out.
Mid-thought pauses in which the agent started speaking before the caller had finished.
Interruptions after which the agent went quiet within the allowed time.
From the start of the caller's interruption to the agent going quiet.
The reply after an interruption mentions what the caller interrupted about.
Filler words during the agent's speech that did not make it stop.
Numbers, dates and similar details found correctly in a transcript of the reply.
Calls where the reply was in the caller's language. A Hinglish caller should get Hindi or Hinglish, not pure English.
Caller turns the agent never answered within the time allowed.

families.name: Mid-thought pause
families.does: Stops for up to three seconds in the middle of a sentence, then finishes it.
families.catches: An agent that answers the half sentence and talks over the caller.

families.name: Barge-in
families.does: Cuts into the agent's answer after one, two or four seconds with a new request.
families.catches: An agent that keeps talking, or carries on with the old answer.

families.name: Backchannel
families.does: Says “mm-hmm”, “हाँ” or “अच्छा” while the agent is explaining.
families.catches: An agent that takes a listening noise for an interruption and stops.

families.name: Numbers and details
families.does: Gives an order number with “double nine”, a phone number in Hindi, a PIN code, a date, a spelled-out email.
families.catches: Details misheard, or read back wrong.

families.name: Background noise
families.does: Speaks over street, crowd or television noise, after four seconds of noise alone.
families.catches: An agent that answers the noise, or cannot hear the caller through it.

families.name: Change of mind
families.catches: An agent that acts on the first version.

families.name: Long silence
families.does: Says nothing for 12 to 15 seconds, then comes back.
families.catches: An agent that never checks in, or is gone when the caller returns.

proof.title: Largest timing error
proof.text: Fake agents with exactly known delays were run through the same engine. All 14 timings were measured to within 30 ms, and all 8 yes-or-no outcomes came out right.

proof.title: Correct answers accepted
proof.text: An agent that is handed the script and says the right reply passed this many scenarios, with 9 of 9 details read correctly. A correct agent is not marked down.

proof.title: Wrong details caught
proof.text: The same agent, made to change one detail in each reply, was caught this many times. A wrong number does not slip through.
